videos.title: Rep. DelBene Says GOP Spending Shows Defensive Shift
videos.description:
Rep. Suzan DelBene (D-WA), DCCC Chair, says Republicans are in “triage mode” and moving resources to defend seats they already hold. Rep. DelBene says Democrats are making spending decisions based on race-level data and conditions on the ground as the House map expands. Rep. DelBene says the DCCC is prioritizing frontliners, incumbents and races where it has already invested before adding support to newly competitive contests as more resources come in. She speaks with Joe Mathieu and Kailey Leinz on Bloomberg’s "Balance of Power."

videos.title: Voters Are Feeling a Deeper Inflation Squeeze: Duppler
videos.description:
Mattie Duppler, Founder and President of Forward Strategies and spokesperson for The Ledger Project, says a rate hike is more likely than not after the latest CPI report came in modestly higher than expected. Duppler says the data itself matters less politically than how Americans are experiencing higher prices for groceries and gas. Duppler says consumers had a pandemic-era financial cushion when prices rose in 2022, while today they are increasingly using credit cards and savings to cover higher costs. Duppler thinks that financial pressure is what voters will be thinking about as they head to the polls. She speaks with Joe Mathieu and Kailey Leinz on Bloomberg’s "Balance of Power."
--------

videos.title: Esper Says Iran Can Still Disrupt Strait of Hormuz
videos.description:
Mark Esper, former US Defense Secretary, says the US controls the Strait of Hormuz, but Iran can still influence how much traffic moves through it by threatening ships, insurers and crews. Esper says Ukraine still has European allies, but pushing back against Russia is harder without full US support, including arms and intelligence. He speaks with Joe Mathieu and Kailey Leinz on Bloomberg’s "Balance of Power."
